stories.title: Eagles' Carter now highest-paid DT in NFL history
stories.summary: The Eagles are signing two-time Pro Bowl selection Jalen Carter to a four-year, $152 million extension worth up to $160 million, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Jason Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Sources: No real progress in Mayfield, Bucs talks
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is reporting to training camp without a new deal and will play out the final year of his contract before becoming a free agent, sources told ESPN Tuesday.

stories.title: Simms: Shanahan nearly lost eye in car crash
stories.summary: Kyle Shanahan nearly lost an eye as a result of his car crash earlier this month, according to Chris Simms, who is close friends with the 49ers coach.
